name: Chhattisgarh

topAttractions.name: Kanger Ghati National Park
topAttractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the largest national parks in India, known for its diverse wildlife and unique geological formations.

topAttractions.name: Tirthgarh Falls
topAttractions.description: A 100-foot high waterfall located in the Kanger Valley National Park, surrounded by lush green forests and offering breathtaking views.

topAttractions.name: Ratanpur
topAttractions.description: A historic town famous for its ancient temples, including the 10th-century Ratanpur Fort and the 12th-century Jagannath Temple.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February, when the weather is cool and pleasant, making it ideal for trekking and wildlife spotting.
culturalFact: Chhattisgarh is home to the ancient Kalchuri dynasty, which ruled the region from the 6th to the 12th century and is known for its contributions to Hinduism and Jainism.

hiddenGem.name: Chitrakoot Waterfalls
hiddenGem.description: A picturesque waterfall located in the Chitrakoot region, surrounded by dense forests and offering stunning views.

relatedFestival: The Bastar Dussehra, a 10-day festival celebrated in the Bastar region, which showcases the rich cultural heritage of the region through music, dance, and traditional performances.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for the Sundarvan National Park, the Kanger Valley National Park, or the Tirthgarh Falls, they will appear here!
